teaser: Each reference's licence, access, links and quotes, reading a paywalled article through its shadow, and paying the sources we use.
core_idea: Every reference carries primitives worth recording (licence, access, links, quotes, quality, history); when an article cannot be read, the shadow of who cites and quotes it is evidence, as Wikipedia's paywalled citations show, and disagreements between shadow and source become visible, building a record of who got it right and a basis for paying the sources used.

not to read around the wall, but to pay through it, per use, for what we actually cite.
